prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a wrist injury diagnosed as a distal radius fracture. The mechanism of injury, a moderate-speed rear impact with airbag deployment, is consistent with the injury sustained. Over the course of 15 visits, the patient received immobilization, serial radiographs showing progressive callus formation, occupational therapy focused on range of motion and grip strengthening, and monitoring for complications. The recovery timeline was somewhat longer than typically expected for this fracture pattern, attributed to stiffness and a slower return of grip strength. Physical examination documented tenderness over the fracture site, reduced wrist flexion and extension, and decreased grip strength on the injured side, while neurovascular testing and sensation remained within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the affected wrist or forearm. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. Current prognosis is guarded but improving, with continued therapy and a follow-up evaluation planned.
